messages:
elaine_cs: Morning team — quick checkpoint for Northlight private VPC ramp. They finished VPC peering/subnets but hit KMS policy errors during dry-run. Need alignment. :wave:

devon_neteng: I checked their VPC routes; control plane IP 35.198.45.12/32 was blocked by their firewall. Asked them to allow outbound TCP 443 to that IP.

raj_security: KMS policy issue: service principal missing. Sent minimal snippet:

```json
{ "Sid":"AllowRedwoodService", "Effect":"Allow", "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service"}, "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource":"*" }
```

raj_security: Also asked for key alias alias/redwood/northlight, rotation on, CloudTrail logging.

harper_sre: For audit logs they must add our ingestion role to their S3 bucket policy and enable object-level logging; shared example earlier. Need retention >=90 days. I'm spinning up verbose captures to s3://rw-onboard-northlight/tmp/

elaine_cs: Customer target: pilot go-live next Mon EOD. AE flagged churn risk if pilot slips >2 weeks.

sophia_ae: Offer a 2-week ramp-assist (no charge) if engs can commit on-call coverage. I'll draft and loop in legal.

devon_neteng: Can customer run this from their bastion and paste output?

```
curl -v https://control.redwood-inference.com/healthz -H "x-customer: northlight"
```

devon_neteng: Need successful TLS handshake + 200. If fails, paste curl errors.

onboard-bot: Dry-run failed: kms:AccessDenied on Encrypt (run 2026-03-18-042). Report: https://console.redwood/reports/2026-03-18-042

elaine_cs: They say firewall updated and policy applied but still see AccessDenied. Devon, could IAM role mapping be wrong on our side?

devon_neteng: Checking role mapping now — two places to confirm: key policy and our assume-role ARN. Will update within 30m.

raj_security: After they re-apply policy I will run the validation and request CloudTrail snippet of failing kms:Encrypt.

harper_sre: Verbose ingress logs enabled. Uploads to s3://rw-onboard-northlight/tmp/verbose-logs.log

sophia_ae: Added renewal_tracker: risk +1 if pilot misses Mon. If ramp-assist committed, will mark mitigated.

elaine_cs: Action items:
- devon_neteng: confirm role ARN mapping + report back (ETA 30m)
- raj_security: re-run KMS validation
- harper_sre: continue verbose logs and share path
- sophia_ae: draft ramp-assist legal comms

elaine_cs: Customer requested a 45m enablement call for KMS + audit logs tomorrow 11am PT. Raj + Harper to present. Any objections?

raj_security: I'm good. I'll prepare 10-15 slides and a short demo cycle.

harper_sre: I'll cover network and audit log verification steps and show CloudTrail event for kms:Encrypt.

elaine_cs: Great. I'll send calendar invite and include AE/Cust Success notes for the call. Will update thread when devon confirms role mapping.

elaine_cs: If KMS validation passes we'll proceed with pilot. If not, escalate to infra-eng standby. :thumbsup:
